Delhi High Court to Hear ED Plea Against Kejriwal's Bail

The Delhi High Court will hear a plea by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) challenging the bail granted to Arvind Kejriwal in the excise policy case. The hearing is scheduled for Monday before Justice Manoj Jain. The ED filed its petition in 2024.
